title: Top Power Banks for Phones, Laptops & Travel (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: Picks were made by cross-referencing recommendations from Tom's Guide, PCMag, CNET, The Great Outdoors Mag, Clever Hiker, and The Prepared. Products recommended by multiple sources or highlighted as top performers in specific categories were prioritized.
assumptions: Prices are not included in the product descriptions as per instructions. The Anker PowerCore 10000 is subject to a recall, which may affect availability or safety.

verdict.line: It is an affordable, compact backup battery that supports Quick Charge 3.0 and can keep a phone running for a day. The main catch is that it is part of an official global recall by Anker.
